craft_notes: Sthāyin: framed count. Sanskrit-first: three marks in one breath. Rows: 3. Close: power counts. Rejected: numerology — killed: śakti-qualifier forbids it. Read aloud: counting cadence — marks, numbers, power.

lines: Parā her womb, fire-word her seal, first her crown —
hundred, thousand, hundred-eight: let power count.
